scope: Real RPLIDAR C1 scans from the 19 October 2026 manual POSHOLD flight on the Pi; mapping-odometry regression only. The aircraft drifted about 1.4 m forward around scans 20-35 of this slice while pitching between +3 and -6 degrees (FCU local position).
ranges_encoding: zlib-compressed little-endian uint16 millimetres, row per scan, 0 = no return
